chapter.heading: The Coming Messenger
chapter.v:
“Behold, I
send My messenger,And he will prepare the way before Me.And the Lord, whom you seek,Will suddenly come to His temple,Even the Messenger of the covenant,In whom you delight.Behold, He is coming,”Says the Lord of hosts. [Acts 9:6 b Acts]

“But who
can endure the day of His coming?And who can stand when He appears?For He is like a refiner’s fireAnd like launderers’ soap.

He will
sit as a refiner and a purifier of silver;He will purify the sons of Levi,And purge them as gold and silver,That they may offer to the LordAn offering in righteousness.

“Then the
offering of Judah and JerusalemWill be pleasant to the Lord,As in the days of old,As in former years. [[Matt. 20:28]]

And I
will come near you for judgment;I will be a swift witnessAgainst sorcerers,Against adulterers,Against perjurers,Against those who exploit wage earners and widows and orphans,And against those who turn away an alien—Because they do not fear Me,”Says the Lord of hosts.

“For I
am the Lord, I do not change;Therefore you are not consumed, O sons of Jacob. [[Rom. 8:28]; Gal. 1:15; 5:8]

Yet from
the days of your fathersYou have gone away from My ordinancesAnd have not kept them.Return to Me, and I will return to you,”Says the Lord of hosts.“But you said,‘In what way shall we return?’Do Not Rob God [Acts 15:1; Gal. 5:10, 12 h 2 Cor.] [2 Cor. 11:4]

“Will a
man rob God?Yet you have robbed Me!But you say,‘In what way have we robbed You?’In tithes and offerings. [1 Cor. 16:22]

You are
cursed with a curse,For you have robbed Me,Even this whole nation. [Deut. 4:2]

Bring all
the tithes into the storehouse,That there may be food in My house,And try Me now in this,”Says the Lord of hosts,“If I will not open for you the windows of heavenAnd pour out for you such blessingThat there will not be room enough to receive it. [[1 Cor. 10:33]; 1 Thess. 2:4 l]

“And all
nations will call you blessed,For you will be a delightful land,”Says the Lord of hosts.The People Complain Harshly [1 Cor. 15:1 p [Eph. 3:3-5]]

“Yourwords have
been harsh against Me,”Says the Lord,“Yet you say,‘What have we spoken against You?’ [Acts 9:1 r Acts]

You have
said,‘It is useless to serve God;What profit is it that we have kept His ordinance,And that we have walked as mournersBefore the Lord of hosts? [Acts 26:9; Phil. 3:6 t Jer. 9:14; Matt. 15:2; Mark 7:3; [Col. 2:8]]

So now
we call the proud blessed,For those who do wickedness are raised up;They even tempt God and go free.’ ”A Book of Remembrance [Is. 49:1, 5; Jer. 1:5; Acts 9:15; Rom. 1:1; Gal. 1:6]

Then those
who feared the Lord spoke to one another,And the Lord listened and heard them;So a book of remembrance was written before HimFor those who fear the LordAnd who meditate on His name. [Acts 9:15; Gal. 2:9 x Matt. 16:17] [[2 Cor. 4:5-7]]

“Theyshall be
Mine,” says the Lord of hosts,“On the day that I make them My jewels.And I will spare themAs a man spares his own son who serves him.”

Then you
shall again discernBetween the righteous and the wicked,Between one who serves GodAnd one who does not serve Him. [Acts 9:26 3 NU]
